name: typing-animation
blurb: Types out words character by character, optionally cycling through multiple phrases with delete animation.
description: Renders text character-by-character with configurable typing and delete speeds. Can cycle through a words array with pause between cycles, or display a single children string. Includes configurable cursor (line, block, underscore).
use_when: Hero text or call-to-action that cycles through several value propositions, with customizable pacing.
avoid_when: Continuous animations; performance degrades with very long strings or many simultaneous instances.
a11y: Text is rendered in the DOM; cursor animation responds to a custom animate-blink-cursor class, does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
